text: あなたの　ポケモン　すこし　よごれちゃってる　みたい！

structure.jp: あなたの　ポケモン
すこし　よごれちゃってる　みたい！
structure.en: seems to have gotten a bit dirty

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is a casual form of てしまう, meaning it happened completely; てる means a state. よごれちゃってる = 'has gotten dirty'.

patterns.name: 〜みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい says 'it seems like'. よごれてるみたい = 'it looks dirty'.
